cases.question: What does C-MAPSS stand for?
cases.reference_answer: Commercial Modular Aero-Propulsion System Simulation.

cases.question: Who published the C-MAPSS dataset?
cases.reference_answer: The NASA Prognostics Center of Excellence.

cases.question: How many sensor measurements are recorded for every operating cycle?
cases.reference_answer: 21 sensor measurements (plus 3 operational settings).

cases.question: Which C-MAPSS subset is the hardest?
cases.reference_answer: FD004: six operating conditions and two fault modes.

cases.question: Why is FD001 a common starting point?
evidence: single operating condition makes the degradation signal easier to learn
cases.reference_answer: Its single operating condition makes the degradation signal easier to learn.

cases.question: What fixes are suggested for overfitting?
evidence: Fixes: more data, regularization, simpler models, cross-validation
cases.reference_answer: More data, regularization, simpler models, cross-validation.

cases.question: What is the difference between supervised and unsupervised learning?
cases.reference_answer: Supervised learning uses labeled examples; unsupervised learning finds structure in unlabeled data.

cases.question: How is precision defined?
evidence: of the items predicted positive, how many were truly positive
cases.reference_answer: Of the items predicted positive, how many were truly positive.

cases.question: How is recall defined?
evidence: of the truly positive items, how many were found
cases.reference_answer: Of the truly positive items, how many were found.

cases.question: What are the steps of the training workflow?
evidence: Split it into training and test sets
cases.reference_answer: Collect and clean data, split into train/test, train a model, evaluate with metrics, tune hyperparameters and repeat.

cases.question: What does ROC-AUC measure?
evidence: how well the model separates classes across thresholds
cases.reference_answer: How well the model separates classes across thresholds.

cases.question: How does reinforcement learning work?
cases.reference_answer: An agent learns by trial and error, receiving rewards or penalties.

cases.question: What is predictive maintenance?
evidence: predict when equipment is likely to fail
cases.reference_answer: A strategy using data and ML to predict when equipment will fail, so maintenance is done just in time.

cases.question: What is the downside of reactive (run-to-failure) maintenance?
cases.reference_answer: It causes unplanned downtime and secondary damage.

cases.question: What kind of data are PdM models usually trained on?
cases.reference_answer: Time-series sensor data such as temperature, pressure, vibration, speed and flow.

cases.question: Why are Random Forest and XGBoost popular for predictive maintenance?
cases.reference_answer: They handle noisy non-linear relationships, are robust to outliers and give feature-importance scores.

cases.question: What is Retrieval-Augmented Generation?
evidence: giving it relevant external information at query time
cases.reference_answer: A technique that improves LLM answers by giving the model relevant external information at query time.

cases.question: How does RAG reduce hallucination?
cases.reference_answer: The model answers from retrieved passages, so it is grounded in real source documents.

cases.question: What happens in the retrieval step of a RAG pipeline?
evidence: the question is embedded and the most similar chunks are retrieved
cases.reference_answer: The question is embedded and the most similar chunks are retrieved, e.g. by cosine similarity.

cases.question: What is top-k?
evidence: the number of passages retrieved for each question
cases.reference_answer: The number of passages retrieved for each question.

cases.question: Which vector databases are mentioned?
cases.reference_answer: Chroma, FAISS and Pinecone.

cases.question: What affects retrieval quality in the chunking strategy?
evidence: chunk size and overlap affect retrieval quality
cases.reference_answer: Chunk size and overlap.

cases.question: How do I stop my model from just memorizing the training set?
evidence: Fixes: more data, regularization, simpler models, cross-validation
cases.reference_answer: That is overfitting; fixes include more data, regularization, simpler models and cross-validation.

cases.question: How can an LLM stay up to date without being retrained?
evidence: update the document store without retraining
cases.reference_answer: Update the document store; no retraining is needed.

cases.question: Which maintenance approach wastes the least component life?
evidence: Minimizes both downtime and wasted part life
cases.reference_answer: Predictive (condition-based) maintenance.

cases.question: Can a model answer questions about my company's internal files it never saw in training?
evidence: answer about internal documents it was never trained on
cases.reference_answer: Yes, RAG adds private knowledge at query time.

cases.question: Is predicting remaining useful life a classification or a regression task?
evidence: predicts a continuous number (e.g. remaining useful life in cycles)
cases.reference_answer: Regression: it predicts a continuous number of cycles.

cases.question: Which dataset is a standard benchmark for predictive maintenance, and which tasks are typically run on it?
evidence: fault-state classification or Remaining Useful Life regression
cases.reference_answer: C-MAPSS; fault-state classification or RUL regression.

cases.question: Which metrics would suit evaluating a healthy/faulty classifier?
cases.reference_answer: Accuracy, precision, recall and ROC-AUC.

cases.question: Що таке перенавчання (overfitting) і як з ним боротися?
evidence: Fixes: more data, regularization, simpler models, cross-validation
cases.reference_answer: Overfitting: the model memorizes training data; fix with more data, regularization, simpler models, cross-validation.

cases.question: Які підмножини має набір даних C-MAPSS?
cases.reference_answer: Four subsets FD001-FD004 differing in operating conditions and fault modes.

cases.question: Чим класифікація відрізняється від регресії?
cases.reference_answer: Classification predicts a category; regression predicts a continuous number.

cases.question: Що таке RAG і навіщо він потрібен?
evidence: giving it relevant external information at query time
cases.reference_answer: Grounding LLM answers in retrieved documents: less hallucination, current and private knowledge.

cases.question: Яку стратегію обслуговування називають предиктивною?
evidence: use sensor data and models to act based on the actual condition
cases.reference_answer: Predictive (condition-based): act on the actual condition of equipment using sensor data and models.
